summary: Elide built-in Object.prototype.valueOf when the receiver is proven to be a non-null object; it returns the same object.

semantics.coercion: ToObject(this), which is identity for an Object

caveats: Do not apply to primitive receivers, which are boxed, or to null/undefined, which throw.
Preserve evaluation of the receiver expression exactly once.

tests.name: receiver expression once
tests.input: let n=0; function f(){n++;return {}}; f().valueOf(); console.log(n);
